name: Plague Doctor
fantasy: A beaked plague doctor with vials and a censer. He fights by control: poison pools, fly swarms, rooting blooms, fog and a last experiment.

directions.name: Toxin
directions.desc: Poison that grows crueller and leaps from the dying to the living.

directions.name: Vermin and Rot
directions.desc: The living plague: Swarmcraft and Corpse Bloom.

skills.name: Pestilence Vial
skills.desc: Lob a vial at a visible ring. It bursts lightly and pools poison within 2.6 m for 3.5 s, lingering 2 s after leaving. Pools of one kind don't stack.

skills.name: Swarmcraft
skills.desc: Send a fly swarm to a spot for 6 s, biting all inside and slowing attacks and casts 25%. Recast to move it, twice. A dodge roll scatters it.

skills.name: Corpse Bloom
skills.desc: Plant a corpse flower. For 6 s it hits everything within 3.5 m every 2 s, snaring anyone standing still for 0.6 s. Players break it in 3 hits.

skills.name: Fog of the Forgotten
skills.desc: Hop 4 m back from the pointer, leaving fog within 6 m for 6 s. Players outside can't see in. Inside, sight is 3.5 m and you move 25% faster. Striking reveals you.

skills.name: Transfusion
skills.desc: For 2 s, take 45% less damage at 70% move speed and cleanse slows, snares and Blight. Then heal what you soaked (max 15% of your life). Attacking ends it.

skills.name: The Last Experiment
skills.desc: Crank a vat for 2.5 s inside an 8 m warning ring. It bursts into a 7 s quarantine of spores, Blight and a 20% slow, freeing a creature that hunts foes. A stun, another skill or walking away bursts it early at 5 m. Players can break the vat (3 hits) or creature (4).

skills.name: Miasma
skills.desc: Smash a censer at your feet: a poison cloud within 4.5 m hangs for 4 s.

skills.name: Contagion
skills.desc: Curse a foe for 6 s, poisoning it. Each second its poison leaps to all within 4 m. If it dies cursed, the plague bursts to all within 5 m.

skills.name: Leech Jar
skills.desc: Lob a leech jar that poisons everything within 3 m for 5 s. Each foe in it (up to 3) heals you 1.5% of your life a second.

rites.name: Stronger Dose
rites.text: Pestilence Vial deals {dmg:toxic}% more damage.

rites.name: Studied Hand
rites.text: +{ene} energy.

rites.name: Virulent Venom
rites.text: All your poison hurts {poison_dmg}% more.

rites.name: Heavy Vapour
rites.text: Your contaminated pools spread {cloud_size}% wider.

rites.name: Lingering Rot
rites.text: Pool poison lingers {poison_dur} s longer after a foe leaves.

rites.name: Measured Doses
rites.text: Pestilence Vial costs {cost:toxic}% less mana.

rites.name: Standing Miasma
rites.text: Every pool lingers {cloud_dur} s longer.

rites.name: Ravenous Swarm
rites.text: Swarmcraft bites {dmg:swarm}% harder.

rites.name: Steady Hands
rites.text: +{dex} dexterity.

rites.name: Teeming
rites.text: The swarm spreads {swarm_size}% wider.

rites.name: Fertile Soil
rites.text: Corpse Bloom recharges {cd:bloom}% faster.

rites.name: Rank Growth

rites.name: Iron-Shod Cane
rites.text: Your cane strikes {dmg:attack}% harder.

rites.name: The Hive Obeys
rites.text: The swarm can be moved {swarm_redirect} more time and lasts {swarm_dur} s longer.

rites.name: Dense Fog
rites.text: Fog of the Forgotten hangs {fog_dur} s longer.

rites.name: Hardened Physician

rites.name: Strangling Roots

rites.name: Larger Tanks

rites.name: Quick Needle

rites.name: Long Fever
rites.text: The quarantine lasts {exp_dur} s longer.

rites.name: Magnum Opus
rites.text: The Last Experiment's quarantine is {exp_size}% wider and it recharges {cd:experiment}% faster.

rites.name: Virulence
rites.text: Your poison deals +{poison_dmg}% damage.

rites.name: Septic Wounds
rites.text: Poisoned foes take +{more}% damage from your blows.

rites.name: Toxic Blood
rites.text: {pct}% of the poison damage you deal heals you.

rites.name: Necrosis
rites.text: Poison grows {grow}% crueller every second a foe stays poisoned (up to +{most}%).

rites.name: Outbreak
rites.text: Your poison lingers {poison_dur} s longer.

rites.name: Plague Carrier

rites.name: Contagion

rites.name: Pandemic

rites.name: Ravenous Swarm

rites.name: Feast of Rot

rites.name: Volatile Reagents

rites.name: Strong Tinctures
